facts.fact: Le Sahel reports the restructured WURI project is building a National Population Register (RNP) to identify and authenticate individuals, with enrolment to start in Niamey's five arrondissements, and the ANEI agency created by decree of 22 April 2026.

Le Sahel reports that the restructured WURI project will fund computerisation of all communes and declaration centres and a new digital platform for civil-status events, aiming at a national civil register (RNEC); only 66% of births are declared.

systems.owner: Direction Generale de l'etat civil, des migrations et des refugies

facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that the WURI project is developing a National Population Register (RNP) under the new agency ANEI, created by decree of 22 April 2026, with enrolment starting in the five arrondissements of Niamey in the coming weeks.
Le Sahel reports that the RNP is to be interoperable with the civil and nationality registers and to authenticate anyone requesting public or private services requiring identification.
